  1. Make sure you say " I feel this when you do this." Not "You make me feel this way." That way you take ownership of your own emotions.  
  2. Give your partner 10 minutes to say what they need to say. Don't respond. Just listen. When they are done try to summarize what they said. Ask them if you have it right.   3. Watch for name calling and the blame game. Those are signs that someone got their feelings hurt and they are lashing out in response.
